title: Finite signed augmented closed rows without exactness
statement:
Use the shared constructions [def-sfb-finite-closed-row-constructions]. Let $X,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $A$ a sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], $i:Z\to X$ a morphism, $m\geq0$, and $W_a\to X$ an ordered family indexed by $a\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$. Write $\mathcal M_X=\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ for module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every subset $s$ of the index set let $W_s=\prod_{a\in s,X}W_a$, with $W_\varnothing=X$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and write $i_s:W_s\to X$, $E_s=i_{s,*}i_s^*$ and $E_Z=i_*i^*$. All inverse images use the inverse-image coefficient ring [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]; $\eta_s:\mathrm{id}\to E_s$ and $\eta_Z:\mathrm{id}\to E_Z$ are the normalized adjunction units [def-sfb-proetale-unit-normalized-adjunction].

A finite signed augmented row consists of the following data and equations. There are natural transformations $r_{s,t}:E_s\to E_t$ for all subsets, with $r_{s,t}\circ\eta_s=\eta_t$ when $s\subseteq t$ and $r_{s,t}=0$ otherwise; and $r_{Z,s}:E_Z\to E_s$ for nonempty $s$, with $r_{Z,s}\circ\eta_Z=\eta_s$. There is an additive functor $D:\mathcal M_X\to\operatorname{CoCh}(\mathcal M_X)$ to integer cochain complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with specified natural isomorphisms
$$\theta_p:D(-)^p\xrightarrow{\sim}T_p:=\bigoplus_{t:\{0,\ldots,p\}\hookrightarrow_{\rm ord}\{0,\ldots,m-1\}}E_{\operatorname{im}t}\quad(p\geq0),$$
where the sums and projections $\pi_t:T_p\to E_{\operatorname{im}t}$ are the canonical finite products of the shared construction. Under $\theta_p$ the differential is its signed deletion-restriction matrix: the component indexed by an increasing $(p+2)$-tuple $t$ is $\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j r_{\operatorname{im}(t\setminus j),\operatorname{im}t}\circ\pi_{t\setminus j}$. Require $D(M)^p$ to be a zero object for $p<0$ or $p\geq m$. Supply a natural transformation $a:E_Z\to D(-)^0$ such that $\pi_t\circ\theta_0\circ a\circ\eta_Z=\eta_{\operatorname{im}t}$ for every singleton tuple $t$.

For every cochain complex $K$, use the shared termwise double complex $B_D(K)^{p,q}=D(K^q)^p$, with row degree first, and its ordinary direct-sum total $C_D(K)^n=\bigoplus_{p+q=n}B_D(K)^{p,q}$ with differential $d_D+(-1)^pD(d_K)$. Write $\iota^D_{p,q}:B_D(K)^{p,q}\to C_D(K)^{p+q}$ for its canonical inclusions. The row data also include a natural chain map $\alpha:E_Z(-)\to C_D(-)$, with $E_Z$ applied termwise, satisfying $\alpha_K^n=\iota^D_{0,n}\circ a_{K^n}$. The functor $D$, its cochain identities, and the chain map $\alpha$ are supplied data satisfying these conditions, not an assertion that arbitrary restriction transformations produce them. No covering, closed-immersion, exactness or epimorphic-unit hypothesis is imposed.

For a scheme morphism $g:Y\to X$, put $A'=g^{-1}A$, let $g^*:\mathcal M_X\to\mathcal M_Y$ be the actual module inverse image, and let $D'$ be row data for $Y\times_XZ\to Y$ and $Y\times_XW_a\to Y$ with coefficients $A'$. Supply intersection isomorphisms $c_s:g^*E_s\xrightarrow{\sim}E'_sg^*$ for nonempty $s$ and a natural transformation of complex-valued functors $\sigma:g^*D\to D'g^*$, where $g^*$ acts termwise on complexes. Define $\operatorname{RowFormula}(D,D',g,c,\sigma)$ by the following projection equations, for every $M\in\mathcal M_X$, $p\geq0$ and increasing $(p+1)$-tuple $t$, with $s=\operatorname{im}t$:
$$\pi'_t\circ\theta'_p\circ\sigma_M^p=c_{s,M}\circ g^*(\pi_t\circ\theta_p).$$
The index $s$ is always nonempty. When the supplied comparisons satisfy $c_s\circ g^*\eta_s=\eta'_sg^*$, they are called unit-compatible; this is a condition on the supplied comparisons, not an additional equation in RowFormula.

For any category $P$ and functor $I:P\to\operatorname{CoCh}(\mathcal M_X)$ in compatible universes, and a natural chain transformation $\tau:g^*C_DI\to C_{D'}g^*I$, define $\operatorname{TotalFormulaOn}(D,D',g,I,\sigma,\tau)$ by requiring, for every $K\in P$ and integers $p,q,n$ with $p+q=n$,
$$\tau_K^n\circ g^*(\iota^D_{p,q})=\iota^{D'}_{p,q}\circ\sigma_{(I K)^q}^{p}.$$
Define TotalFormula as TotalFormulaOn for the inclusion of the full subcategory of bounded-below complexes, meaning complexes whose terms are zero objects below some integer. These predicates specify equations for supplied transformations; they assert neither their existence nor invertibility.
